groups.why_chosen: Four-panel comparison: a legend table defining three coloured path variables, a shared background-traffic graph, then two solutions overlaying different numeric splits on those same coloured paths.
groups.what_to_learn: Define each alternate path's colour once in a legend table, redraw the identical background graph per solution, and change only the numbers stacked on each coloured edge — but two stacked numbers per short segment make the graph dense.
